sessionEnd.prompt: Open loop reminder (Daily Work Loop): Session is ending ($ARGUMENTS). If this session likely included code or PR activity and the user did not run /eod-wrap, remind them once in a single sentence to run /eod-wrap to capture draft work-item updates and open loops. This is advisory only and must not block session close. If /eod-wrap already ran, or there was no code activity, respond ok with no user message.
